name: Sun Cleric: Injunction taunts and engages an out-of-combat enemy (#5235)
contract: Injunction 800624 (Sun Cleric level-14 class grant, family 33) must force its target to attack the caster AND put both in combat. EFFECT_ATTACK_ME (114) on a threat-list creature calls ThreatManager::MatchUnitThreatToHighestThreat against an empty list and adds nothing, and the launch-phase SetInCombatWith gate requires HasInitialAggro or an engaged target. If the record carries EFFECT_THREAT (63) instead, EffectThreat calls ThreatManager::AddThreat, whose own body documents 'threat implies combat' via SetInCombatWith before applying. The discriminator is the enemy's combat flag after the cast, mirroring bloodmage-blood-howl.json.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: enemy starts out of combat
CONTRACT: the taunted creature is in combat with the caster
